name: The Bully I Hate
source:
You take on the role of a lonely and depressed guy, who is being harassed by pretty girls. There are three bullies to get your attention: Alex, the blonde, Rosemarie, with her beautiful black hair like a summer sky next to the full moon, and the little Emilie, a big naughty (well I mean "mean") girl.

---

The game is currently on hiatus.
